system.description:
+1 to any 2 of your stats. Your soul power is 5d8. When you use a Soul Rite on a Soul Touched, you can target a 2nd Soul Touched in Reach.

[A] Soul power becomes 5d8 automatically on Soul Twist and every Rite. The +1 to 2 stats is handled by the level-up dialog.

[A] Target both Soul Touched creatures when you use the Rite — the module removes both marks (chat card with Undo). Without this feature a Rite removes only one mark; extra targets keep theirs (with a warning).
